# Flow AI Video

> Flow AI Video is an AI video generator for text to video and image to video creation: 4K cinematic output, multi-shot storytelling, diverse visual styles and fast rendering in one browser studio.

## Essentials

- Site: https://flowaivideo.lol
- What it does: turn a text prompt or a still image into a cinematic 4K video in the browser
- Models: Gemini Omni Flash, Veo 3.1, Seedance 2.5, Kling, Wan 2.5, Nano Banana, GPT Image 2
- Capabilities: text to video, image to video, reference to video, multi-shot consistency, 4K HD output, ultra-fast processing
- Billing: Basic, Professional and Enterprise subscriptions, monthly or annual, plus one-time credit packs
- Support: support@flowaivideo.lol

## Pages

- [Home](https://flowaivideo.lol/): studio, sample videos, feature overview, how it works, pricing summary, stats and FAQ
- [Pricing](https://flowaivideo.lol/pricing): subscription plans and credit packs with the full pricing FAQ

## Notes

- English only.
- Credits are the usage unit for generation; credits are shown before a run starts.
- Plans and packs are billed securely through Stripe.
